definitions.explanation: The raised platform at the front of a classroom where the teacher stands.
Figuratively refers to the profession of teaching. Used in expressions like "standing at the podium" meaning to teach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{教壇|きょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher stood at the podium.

examples.japanese: {教壇|きょうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見|み}わたした。
examples.english: I looked out over the students from the platform.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教壇|きょうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Old classrooms still have wooden teacher's platforms.

examples.japanese: {教壇|きょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has been thirty years since I started teaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧{教壇|きょうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{去|さ}った→去る：02115_saru⟧。
examples.english: He retired and left the teaching profession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{卒業後|そつぎょうご}⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{教壇|きょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I started teaching right after graduating from university and continue to teach to this day.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (sense 1) refers to the raised platform in a classroom. Many modern Japanese schools have removed these platforms, but the word persists in its figurative meaning.

The expression {教壇|きょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand at the podium) is the most common usage and means "to teach" or "to be a teacher."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教壇|きょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to teach, to be a teacher)
- {教壇|きょうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧ (to leave the teaching profession)
- {教壇|きょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧〜⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (to have been teaching for ~ years)
